## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Vatican City, Vatican. It starts at Via del Corso 305.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover one of Rome's grandest art collections, with a visit to the spectacular Doria Pamphilj Gallery. Once the domain of rich aristocrats, the unassuming facade of the building gives way to reveal an astonishing opulent interior.
>
> Floor-to-ceiling paintings adorn the walls, and masters such as Raphael, Tintoretto, Titian, Caravaggio, and Velázquez are just some of the artists represented in this magnificent collection. Grab a ticket and explore this hidden cultural gem.
>
> When in Rome...

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €32.62. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 209 ratings and 103 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
